name: Huhtamäki Oyj
summary: Huhtamäki Oyj provides packaging solutions in the United States, Germany, the United Kingdom, India, Turkey, Australia, Thailand, Poland, South Africa, Spain, Finland, and internationally. It operates through Foodservice Packaging, North America, Flexible Packaging, and Fiber Packaging segments.
